{{Quote|Knowledge is power. Our enemies possess the secrets to their own annihilation. We must learn everything.|Chaskar|<ref name="An Unthinkable Alliance" />}}
'''Chaskar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood Sith]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] who served the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="An Unthinkable Alliance" />

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] was captured along with the other members of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|strike team]] sent to capture the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] himself, Chaskar was appointed as one of the Knight's teachers in the ways of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] aboard the [[Emperor's Fortress]]. After some time, the Hero broke free of the Emperor's [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|mental control]] with the help of the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of the Jedi's former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Orgus Din]]. Chaskar called the Knight to another training session, unaware that his student had broken free from the Emperor's influence. During the session, in which the Hero was to torture [[Kira Carsen]] for information, the Knight was able to [[Mind trick/Legends|influence]] Chaskar into departing so that the Hero and the Jedi's allies could escape the [[Space station/Legends|station]].<ref name="An Unthinkable Alliance" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Chaskar appears only in the Jedi Knight class mission "An Unthinkable Alliance," which bridges the gap between Acts II and III for the class in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. There were three options to get rid of him. The first two were the light side options of either mind tricking him to leave or knocking him out, while the third dark side option was to kill him.
